name: Critical Mass
summary: **Critical Mass** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Mr. Nice Seedbank]], founded in the Netherlands in 1998. A cross of [[afghani]] and [[skunk-1]], it was developed as an improved, heavier-yielding version of the older [[big-bud]]. A phenotype selected in Bilbao, Spain, known as Critical Bilbo, spread through home-grow circles across Spain.

sources.title: Critical Mass by Mr. Nice, a legendary cannabis strain
